summary: Iteration 38 testing complete - Auto-Retrain Scheduler. All 30 backend tests passed (100%). New scheduler endpoints for scheduled ML model retraining at market open times (London 08:00 UTC, NY 13:00 UTC, Mon-Fri) are working correctly. Frontend dashboard loads successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: AutoRetrainScheduler correctly implements asyncio background task for scheduled retraining
Scheduler config includes all required fields: enabled, retrain_hours_utc [8,13], retrain_days [0-4], min_hours_between_retrain, use_otc_data, use_oanda_data, timeframes, symbols_oanda, symbols_otc
_should_retrain_now() correctly checks: weekday in retrain_days, hour in retrain_hours_utc, minute < 2, and min interval since last retrain
Manual trigger respects 30min cooldown between retrains
Scheduler history tracks: started_at, status, completed_at, duration_seconds, models_trained, models_count
Config can be updated at runtime via PUT /api/ml/scheduler/config without restart
seed_data_creation: None - used existing OANDA market data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 38 features tested: 1) GET /api/ml/scheduler/status returns running state, config (enabled, retrain_hours_utc [8,13], retrain_days [0-4], min_hours_between_retrain, use_otc_data, use_oanda_data, timeframes, symbols_oanda, symbols_otc, min_otc_candles), last_retrain, next_scheduled, retrain_count, recent_history. 2) POST /api/ml/scheduler/start starts the asyncio background task. 3) POST /api/ml/scheduler/stop stops the scheduler. 4) PUT /api/ml/scheduler/config updates config at runtime. 5) POST /api/ml/scheduler/trigger triggers immediate manual retrain (may timeout >30s but runs in background, respects 30min cooldown). 6) Regression tests passed: /api/signals/engine-status, /api/signals/decision, /api/ml/tuning-report, /api/signals/iq720-ensemble, /api/health. 7) Frontend dashboard loads correctly.

scheduler_status_endpoint.notes: Returns running state, config (all fields), last_retrain, next_scheduled, retrain_count, recent_history

scheduler_start_endpoint.notes: Starts asyncio background task, returns success and current status

scheduler_stop_endpoint.notes: Stops the scheduler, cancels background task

scheduler_config_endpoint.notes: Updates config at runtime without restart. Supports: enabled, retrain_hours_utc, retrain_days, min_hours_between_retrain, use_otc_data, use_oanda_data, timeframes, symbols_oanda, symbols_otc

scheduler_trigger_endpoint.notes: Triggers immediate manual retrain. May timeout (>30s) but retrain runs in background. Respects 30min cooldown.

scheduler_history.notes: recent_history shows completed retrains with started_at, status, completed_at, duration_seconds, models_trained, models_count

regression_tests.iq720_ensemble: PASSED - /api/signals/iq720-ensemble returns response (success=false when no signal is valid)
